request.prompt: Redraw this app icon cleanly as a new flat vector illustration, not a pixel copy. Keep the same composition: the head and neck of a white robot duck, three-quarter view, one large round violet eye with two small white highlights, a small orange beak pointing toward a violet cube in the lower-right corner, a dark indigo (#1A1240) rounded square, white outside it. Same flat style with thick, even dark outlines and rounded shapes. Exactly three colours on the indigo: white, violet (#7C4DFF) and orange (beak only); no gradients, no shading, no grey or lavender shadows, the cube in flat violet with its edges drawn as outlines. No text, no letters. Subject large and centred with a 15% margin; it must read at 48x48 pixels.

input_image.made_with: an earlier reference image supplied by the author

saved_png.processing: white outside the rounded square made transparent (alpha, antialiased rim kept); cropped to the square (1600 px of 1600) and resized to 1024 (Lanczos)
